compile_tsp_executable: compile a C++ TSP solver source file into an optimized binary executable with g++
run_runner_parallel: run multiple TSP configuration files in parallel using asyncio with automatic worker scaling
decide_workers: calculate the optimal number of parallel workers based on available RAM and CPU cores
estimate_mem_gb_for_config: estimate the memory in gigabytes required to solve a TSP problem from its config file
available_ram_gb: get the currently available system RAM in gigabytes using psutil
